schema_note: kind in {commercial, hf_classifier, zero_shot}; score_semantics states what 1.0 (or the score direction) means; verified=false means the spec could not be confirmed against official docs/model files.

specs.name: GPTZero
specs.suggested_env_var: GPTZERO_API_KEY
specs.score_semantics: 1.0 = document fully AI-generated. class_probabilities has keys human/ai/mixed (sum to 1). For 'any AI involvement' use ai + mixed. documents[0].completely_generated_prob is DEPRECATED.
specs.sentence_scores_path: documents[0].sentences[*].generated_prob
specs.notes: Also returns documents[0].predicted_class (human|ai|mixed), confidence_category (high|medium|low|reject; 'high' targets <1% error), document_classification (HUMAN_ONLY|MIXED|AI_ONLY), subclass.ai.class_probabilities {pure_ai, ai_paraphrased}, subclass for mixed {concatenated, polished}, and per-sentence perplexity + highlight_sentence_for_ai. Example response version '2026-10-07-base' / neatVersion '4.1o'. Pin modelVersion (list via GET /v2/model-versions/ai-scan) so before/after comparisons use one model. A mis-sent key silently falls back to free-plan rate limits (429). Non-English text is routed to a multilingual model automatically. Pricing/free tier: not stated in the API docs read (UNVERIFIED; see gptzero.me pricing page).

specs.name: Pangram
specs.suggested_env_var: PANGRAM_API_KEY
specs.score_semantics: Fraction (0-1) of the text in windows labelled AI-generated; 1.0 = whole text AI. Add fraction_ai_assisted for 'any AI involvement'; fraction_human is the complement.
specs.sentence_scores_path: windows[*].ai_assistance_score
specs.notes: ASYNC: POST /task returns {task_id}; poll GET /task/{task_id} until stage == 'STAGE_SUCCESS' or 'STAGE_FAILED' (in-progress e.g. 'STAGE_PREPROCESSING'). Success payload: version ('4.0'/'4.1'), headline, prediction, prediction_short, fraction_ai, fraction_ai_assisted, fraction_human, num_*_segments, windows[] each with text, label (e.g. 'AI-Assisted', 'Human Written'), ai_assistance_score, confidence (High|Medium|Low), start_index, end_index, word_count, token_length, is_humanized, humanizer_score (Pangram 4 humanizer head). Send 'model' explicitly ('pangram-4' or 'default'); minor versions within a series can change without notice. Errors: 401 bad key, 402 insufficient credits, 403 model not enabled, 422 bad body, 429 QPS limit (respect Retry-After), 503 model unavailable. Billing unit: one started 100-word block per item for Pangram 4. Price per unit: docs link to pangram.com/pricing only (UNVERIFIED here); a 'Developers' plan exists per Pangram's knowledge hub title. Python SDK: pip install pangram; Pangram().predict(text, model='pangram-4'). Not on the RAID leaderboard.

specs.name: Originality.ai
specs.suggested_env_var: ORIGINALITY_API_KEY
specs.score_semantics: Documented model-5.0 response has NO document-level probability: results.ai.prediction_label (e.g. 'human') plus results.ai.ai_assisted_percent (0-100). Wrapper should report prediction_label and derive p_ai = mean(results.ai.sentences[*].ai_score) as a continuous score; verify on a live call.
specs.sentence_scores_path: results.ai.sentences[*].ai_score
specs.notes: Sentence entries carry start_index, end_index, text, ai_score (0-1). Models: 'model-5.0', 'model-5.0-max'; legacy 'lite'/'turbo' marked deprecated; AI-Allowance and 'multilang' models targeted for retirement 2026-12-11. API requires an Enterprise-level subscription. Rate limit 500 requests/minute (429 beyond). Accounts AUTO-TOP-UP credits by default - disable before running automated loops. The RAID harness used the legacy /api/v1/scan/ai endpoint with score.ai, which no longer matches v3. Not on RAID leaderboard submissions.

specs.name: Copyleaks AI Text Detector
specs.suggested_env_var: COPYLEAKS_EMAIL,COPYLEAKS_API_KEY
specs.score_semantics: summary.ai and summary.human are shares (0-1) of the text classified AI vs human; 1.0 = all text classified AI. Per-section results[*].probability is the model probability for that section's classification (1 = Human, 2 = AI-generated).
specs.sentence_scores_path: results[*].probability (section-level; spans in results[*].matches[*].text.chars.starts/lengths)
specs.notes: Two-step auth: POST https://id.copyleaks.com/v3/account/login/api with {'email','key'} -> access_token (example shows ~48 h validity); cache it - the login endpoint answers 429 with a 5-minute block. scanId is client-chosen, 3-36 chars, unique per scan. sensitivity 1 (conservative) .. 3 (sensitive), default 2, affects English only with current model. explain=true adds 'AI Logic' pattern statistics. sandbox=true is free and intended for integration testing (do not use its output as an evaluation). Billing: 1 credit per 250 words (scannedDocument.expectedCredits). Example modelVersion 'v11.0'. Not on RAID leaderboard.

specs.name: Sapling AI Detector
specs.suggested_env_var: SAPLING_API_KEY
specs.score_semantics: 0-1, 1.0 = AI-like; decision threshold 0.5. ai_fraction = share of text in sentences scoring >= 0.5 (better for partially AI documents). verdict is 'ai'/'human'.
specs.sentence_scores_path: sentence_scores[*].score
specs.notes: At least 300 characters recommended; low_confidence + low_confidence_reasons (e.g. 'short_text') flag unreliable results. Also returns segments[], token_probs[] and optional HTML heatmap (score_string). Default model upgraded 2026-11-03 (scores change for unpinned requests); available versions include 20251027, 20260820, 20261102, 20261104 (current default) and multilingual ml20261104 - pin 'version' for reproducible before/after comparisons. zero_retention=true avoids storage. Limits: free-trial keys 50,000 characters per 24 h; subscribed keys 10M per 24 h by default. Pricing from $0.005 per 1,000 characters. Not on RAID leaderboard.

specs.name: Winston AI
specs.suggested_env_var: WINSTON_API_KEY
specs.score_semantics: INVERTED: 'human score' 0-100, 100 = human. Convert with p_ai = 1 - score/100.
specs.sentence_scores_path: sentences[*].score  (0-100, assumed human-oriented like the document score; verify live)
specs.notes: Texts under 600 characters 'may produce unreliable results'. Response also has attack_detected.{zero_width_space, homoglyph_attack} and readability_score. version options 5.2 (default, latest) back to 3.0; 'latest' floats. 402 = insufficient credits. The RAID harness used a legacy endpoint (functions/v1/predict). RAID top entry (vendor submission 2026-09-24).

specs.name: Hive AI-Generated Text Detection
specs.suggested_env_var: HIVE_API_KEY
specs.score_semantics: 0-1, 1.0 = AI-generated (aggregate over chunks).
specs.sentence_scores_path: status[0].response.output[*].classes[0].ai_generated  (2048-character chunks with start_index/end_index)
specs.notes: The API key is per Hive project; the project must be configured for the AI-generated text model. The docs show the result object under 'task.status.output'; the outer envelope path (status[0]) is taken from Hive's v2 task format and should be confirmed on a live call - a wrapper should search recursively for 'aggregate_score'. The sync-task page also shows host api.hivemoderation.com. Pricing and text limits not stated in the pages read. Not on RAID leaderboard.

specs.name: Grammarly AI Detection API (Beta)
specs.suggested_env_var: GRAMMARLY_CLIENT_ID,GRAMMARLY_CLIENT_SECRET
specs.score_semantics: average_confidence: confidence that the document is AI-generated (0-1, 1.0 = AI). score.ai_generated_percentage: share of document (0-1) classified AI.
specs.notes: Three steps: (1) POST returns score_request_id and a pre-signed file_upload_url; (2) PUT the file (txt/doc/docx/odt/rtf, <= 4 MB) to that URL within 120 s, no auth header; (3) poll GET /ecosystem/api/v1/ai-detection/{score_request_id} until status == 'COMPLETED' (or FAILED). Minimum 30 words. Rate limits: 10 req/s POST, 50 req/s GET; back off on 429 (base 2 s). Organisation (enterprise) credentials required; OAuth token endpoint not transcribed here. No sentence-level scores. RAID entry 2026-02-09.
